context.content: Come on now, we can't go around demanding things to be *simple*! We already got rid of the voter number, what more do you want? Seriously though, it's dumb. I do get why one wouldn't want to change the numbers that are already attributed, but what I don't understand is why we don't just pick a date and give everyone born after that the same number for everything. Like... the systems are already integrated, you won't need to change anything.
